heading: About Me
roles: Cyber Security Professional, Cyber Security Intern, Virtual Intern
bio: Cyber security professional pursuing a Master of Applied Computing co-op with a Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security and hands-on experience across vulnerability assessment, security documentation, and cyber risk reporting within cross-functional, consulting-style environments. Skilled at coordinating multiple concurrent tasks and projects, with strong verbal and written communication and organizational skills applied to security assessments, technical documentation, and stakeholder-ready reporting that support risk assessment, remediation tracking, and compliance with organizational standards.
quote: I'm a lifelong learner and innovator, driven by a desire to contribute with new ideas and tools that deliver real value.
